一、天庭召
破军和水镜接到天庭召令那日，长安落了第一场秋雨。
细雨如丝，斜斜地织成一片迷蒙的帘幕，将远处的终南山隐在云雾里。杨宅院中的桂花被雨水打落，铺了一地碎金。
水镜站在廊下，伸手接住一片飘落的桂花瓣，轻轻叹了口气。
“要走了”破军的声音从身后传来。
她没有回头，只是望着雨幕中的远方。
“七日。”她说，“述职加整编，最快也要七日。”
破军走到她身侧，与她并肩而立。
七日。
上一次她去天庭受封，人间过了七日。那七日里，暗影议会倾巢而出，杨思纯重伤垂死，白虹以命换命，留下了那三生纠缠的因果。
这一次，又是七日。
“会出事。”破军说，不是疑问，是陈述。
水镜转头看他，眼底有淡淡的忧虑。
“你也感应到了？”
破军点头。
暗影议会最近太过安静。自从上次在长安城下铩羽而归，他们就像蛰伏的毒蛇，收敛了所有气息，隐入了暗处。可破军活了三千多年，太清楚这种安静意味着什么——不是退缩，是酝酿更猛烈的反击。
“我可以不去。”水镜说。
破军摇头。

“天庭召令，违者视为叛逃。”他说，“你刚受封，根基未稳，不能冒险。”
水镜沉默。
她知道他说得对。可她望着这方庭院，望着那三株并蒂莲，望着廊下那几道熟悉的身影——永珍在厨房忙碌，白虹坐在窗边看书，杨思纯抱着清澜在回廊另一头教她认字，清澜奶声奶气地念着“天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒”。
她舍不得。
“我们尽快回来。”她轻声说。
破军握住她的手。
破军的眼神平静而坚定：“我们用最短的时间完成述职。”
水镜望着他，眼底的忧虑渐渐化开，变成温柔的笑意。
“好。”她说。
---
二、暗涌
破军和水镜离开后的第三日，灵石盘开始异动。
江流云盯着那枚悬浮在半空中的玉简，眉头紧锁。玉简表面原本平稳流淌的灵光，此刻正像被什么东西干扰一般，忽明忽暗，频率越来越快。
“不止一处。”沈轻烟的水晶球里，光影狂乱，“东、南、西、北，四个方向同时有时空波动，正在朝长安逼近。”
“包围圈？”惜若抱剑而立，眉心的鲤印微微发光。
“不像。”江流云摇头，“波动太分散，不像是集结进攻，更像是……在布设什么。”
胡嗖捋着长须，沉吟道：“暗影议会上次吃了仙灵力压制的亏，这次恐怕会变本加厉。老夫担心，他们会不会弄出什么更厉害的东西来。”
白虹从门外走进来，脸色微凝。
“不是‘会不会’。”她说，“是‘已经’。”
她将一枚碎裂的玉简放在桌上。那是她安插在城外的暗哨传来的最后一道讯息，只来得及发出两个字：

“压制。”
众人的脸色都变了。
灵力压制器。
上一次那东西让联盟的战力折损过半，杨思纯因此重伤垂死，白虹因此与他魂魄共融。如果暗影议会这次带来的是升级版——
“范围。”杨思纯的声音从门口传来。他抱着清澜，把她交给永珍，然后大步走进来，“能探测到覆盖范围吗？”

1. The call from heaven
On the day Po Jun and Shui Jing received the order from heaven, the first autumn rain fell in Chang'an.
The drizzle is like silk, weaving diagonally into a misty curtain, hiding the distant Zhongnan Mountain in the clouds and mist. The sweet-scented osmanthus in Yang's courtyard was knocked down by the rain, and the ground was covered with gold.
Shui Jing stood in the corridor, reached out to catch a falling osmanthus petal, and sighed softly.
"We're leaving" Po Jun's voice came from behind.
She didn't look back, just looked into the distance in the rain.
"Seven days." She said, "The debriefing plus reorganization will take seven days at the earliest."
Po Jun walked to her side and stood shoulder to shoulder with her.
Seven days.
The last time she went to heaven to be sealed, seven days passed in the human world. In those seven days, the Shadow Council came out in full force. Yang Sichun was seriously injured and dying. Bai Hong exchanged his life for his life, leaving behind the entangled cause and effect of three lives.
This time, it’s seven days again.
"Something will happen." Po Jun said, not as a question, but as a statement.
Shui Jing turned to look at him, with a hint of worry in her eyes.
"Did you feel it too?"
Po Jun nodded.
The Shadow Council has been too quiet lately. Since the last time they returned from defeat at Chang'an City, they were like dormant poisonous snakes, restraining all their aura and hiding in the darkness. Ke Pojun has lived for more than three thousand years, and he knows very well what this kind of silence means - not retreat, but preparation for a more violent counterattack.
"I don't have to go." Shui Jing said.
Po Jun shook his head.
"Heaven calls the order, and anyone who violates it will be regarded as defecting." He said, "You have just been granted the title, and your foundation is not stable, so you cannot take risks."
Shui Jing was silent.
She knew he was right. But she looked at the courtyard, at the three side-by-side lotus plants, and at the familiar figures in the corridor - Yongzhen was busy in the kitchen, Bai Hong was sitting by the window reading, Yang Sichun was holding Qinglan in his arms at the other end of the corridor and teaching her how to read, Qinglan was reciting "The sky and the earth are black and yellow, the universe is primitive".
She couldn't bear it.
"We'll come back as soon as possible," she said softly.
Po Jun held her hand.
Po Jun's eyes were calm and firm: "We will complete the debriefing in the shortest possible time."
Shui Jing looked at him, and the worry in her eyes gradually melted away, turning into a gentle smile.
"Okay." she said.
---
2. Undercurrent
On the third day after Po Jun and Shui Jing left, the spirit stone disk began to move strangely.
Jiang Liuyun stared at the jade slip suspended in mid-air, frowning. The spiritual light that was originally flowing smoothly on the surface of the jade slip seemed to be disturbed by something at this moment, flickering on and off with an increasing frequency.
"More than one place." In Shen Qingyan's crystal ball, light and shadow were crazy, "East, south, west, north, time and space fluctuate in four directions at the same time, approaching Chang'an."
"Encirclement?" Xiruo stood with her sword in her arms, the carp mark between her eyebrows glowing slightly.
"It doesn't look like it." Jiang Liuyun shook his head. "The fluctuations are too scattered. It doesn't look like a mass attack, but more like... setting up something."
Hu Sui stroked his long beard and muttered: "The Shadow Council suffered from the suppression of fairy spiritual power last time, and I am afraid it will get worse this time. I am worried that they will come up with something more powerful."
Bai Hong walked in from the door, her face slightly condensed.
"It's not 'will'," she said, "but 'already'."
She placed a broken jade slip on the table. That was the last message from the secret sentry she planted outside the city. She only had time to say two words:
"Suppression."
Everyone's expressions changed.
Spiritual suppressor.
The last time that thing destroyed more than half of the alliance's combat power, Yang Sichun was seriously injured and dying, and Bai Hong merged with his soul. If the Shadow Council brings an upgraded version this time——
"Scope." Yang Sichun's voice came from the door. He hugged Qinglan, handed her to Yongzhen, and then strode in, "Can you detect the coverage?"
